8297.title: Existing daemon service settings are not reconciled
8297.rootCauseOneLine: Installer OOM defaults are not reconciled into existing systemd units by daemon package updates or the current startup path.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — directionally addresses the root cause
prReviews.topFinding: Startup reconciliation targets the gap; verify retry behavior after daemon-reload failure. PR code was not executed.

8297.proposedFix: Reconcile missing defaults in owned systemd units during startup, preserve operator choices, and reload without restarting; keep reload failures retryable.
8297.caveats: Two clean trusted runs confirm unchanged persisted units at the updater boundary. npm is intercepted, daemon startup is reviewed statically, and no systemd or kernel OOM event is available. Open PR #8298 already closes the issue. Existing tests pass 38/38 with umask 022.
